_description: Model replacements by identity kit (a hairstyle, say): kit id -> a model file under data/models, or { "chathead": path, "model": path }. "chathead" is shown in dialogue in place of the kit's chathead; "model" in game in place of the kit's own model (the hair, for a head kit). A bare path is a chathead. Both apply to every player with the kit. Female head kits are 45-55, 118-128, 141-143, 152 and 154-200; their originals are in data/models/player-chathead/female/<kit>/ (chathead.dat, hair.dat).
